summary: Examples test whether /etc/hosts is a link and select symlinks from a list of paths.
questions: How do I list symlinks from a set of local paths?

answer_card.title: link test examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
ismyhostsalink: "{{ '/etc/hosts' is link }}"
list_of_symlinks: "{{ list_of_paths | select('link') }}"
```
